Future Engineer Scholarship

One recipient receives a $10,000 scholarship.

Applicants must be U.S. citizens and residents of Texas.

Eligible applicants must have a minimum GPA of 3.5, a minimum SAT score of 1200, or a minimum ACT score of 26.

Applicants must major in Computer Science.

Applicants must submit an essay with the application.

Only first-generation college students are eligible.

Leadership is preferred and is considered in the selection criteria.

Eligible household income must be below $75,000.

AP courses are considered and preferred.

The award is renewable for four years.

Selection is based on academic merit and demonstrated financial need.

The application deadline is October 15, 2027.
